segments.text: Glean, the self-hosted RSS reader designed for reading enthusiasts. Glean offers a clean, distraction-free view and automatic filtering so you only see
what matters. Subscribe to any RSS or Atom feed and organize everything with multi-level folders and tags. See something important? Hit read later or
save external links. Glean keeps everything tidy with auto cleanup and background syncing every 15
